evidence: Here we report the use of single particle cryo-EM to identify multiple proteins from three enriched heterogeneous fractions prepared from human liver mitochondrial lysate.
Mitochondria isolated from liver tissue were purchased from Xenotech (BioIVT).

the peak 1, peak 2, and peak 3 mitochondrial lysate enriched from the Superdex 200 column (GE Healthcare) were individually aliquoted (2.0 μl from each lysate peak) and subjected to LC-MS/MS analysis (one biological repeat for each peak)
Enrichment of the human liver mitochondrial lysate using size-exclusion chromatography resulted in three major protein peaks
